policy: No separate exploratory screen: the certified run is the only search.
At most one attempt per route under this delta (creation-only route directory); a further attempt or limit change needs a new parent decision.
At most one C311+cuts pipeline at a time (advisory lock on the driver file).
Admission refused while evidence/k3cubes/C311cuts.QUARANTINE.json exists; code never removes it.
Lane at most 4 busy processes and 8 GiB; B/C411 r5, the authorised B/C321 r6 retry and parent A replays keep priority; C311+cuts runs only when a slot is free and after parent GO.
guards: Fresh gate >= 12.2e9 + 10 MiB projected retained growth before preparation and again before the native pipeline; below gate: UNKNOWN receipt, no native stage, report once, wait.

Preparation, pipeline and generator r3 each run inside stage_guard_r1.StageGuard over the process and every descendant (libproc PROC_PPID_ONLY): aggregate RSS <= 3.5 GiB, 12e9 floor, stage wall cap; sampler exceptions trip (fail closed); SIGTERM to descendants with a 30 s bounded wait; survivors quarantined; no SIGKILL; no subprocess timeout.
SIGTERM handlers for the whole driver run: external SIGTERM stops the active stage and gives UNKNOWN.
The pipeline additionally keeps proof_stream.watch: 15-minute checkpoints, keepalive writer, its RSS/floor/wall/checker-before-writer stops.
No CNF or proof file: strengthened bytes are fed from memory into two FIFOs (solver, checker) with per-feed SHA and byte counts; binary DRAT solver -> FIFO -> drat-trim stdin.
Retained growth: logs, checkpoints, FIFO nodes and one receipt per route.
acceptance_predicate: VERIFIED_UNSAT_CASE iff solver rc 20, checker rc 0, checker status lines exactly [b"s VERIFIED"] and solver status lines exactly [b"s UNSATISFIABLE"] (bytes; remove only b"\r"; split on b"\n"; no stripping), no safety stop, no stage trip, no survivors, both measured feeds equal the precomputed strengthened SHA and length (which equals the controls receipt value), no feed thread alive, and solver/checker binaries equal their pins; SAT_PATTERN_ONLY iff solver rc 10 (Boolean pattern only); all else UNKNOWN, never relabelled.
